name: Ningchengopterus
isnote: The juvenile holotype could not be identified more precisely than Pterodactyloidea.
sum: Hatchling pterodactyloid from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Inner Mongolia, China, preserved with its flight membrane.
holotype: CYGB-0035 — Yixian Formation, Ningcheng, Inner Mongolia.
material: Almost complete articulated skeleton of a hatchling on plate and counterplate.
exceptional: Wing membrane and pycnofibres preserved; supports the idea that young pterosaurs could fly soon after hatching.
biology: About fifty conical, pointed teeth suggest a fish-eater.
author: Lü 2009

species.name: Ningchengopterus liuae
species.author: Lü 2009
